_about: High and critical npm advisories in what ships that are triaged and accepted for now. Debt to clear by upgrading, not a list of things that are fine. See scripts/audit-check.mjs.

accepted.@expo/cli: high; flagged through cacache and tar below, and its own config packages (moderate: glob, uuid). Build-time only, not in the app bundle; triaged 2026-11-19 (D093). Fixed only by moving to Expo SDK 58, a separate piece of work.
accepted.cacache: high; flagged through tar and glob. Used by the Expo CLI's cache when building. Build-time only, not in the app bundle; triaged 2026-11-19 (D093). Fixed only by moving to Expo SDK 58, a separate piece of work.
accepted.image-size: high; DoS on crafted JXL, HEIF or ICNS files (GHSA-5p2g-fcmc-qvqq, GHSA-w3rx-r6r6-pgpr). Metro reads the size of our own image assets with it; 2.x changes the API Metro calls. Build-time only, not in the app bundle; triaged 2026-11-19 (D093). Fixed only by moving to Expo SDK 58, a separate piece of work.
accepted.tar: critical; path traversal and DoS on crafted archives. The Expo CLI extracts template tarballs from npm with it, and only when the system tar fails; 7.x has no default export, which the CLI loads. Build-time only, not in the app bundle; triaged 2026-11-19 (D093). Fixed only by moving to Expo SDK 58, a separate piece of work.
